data.long_meaning: The name Carrol is derived from the Old English word 'carole', which means 'dear, precious one'. In Middle English, it was used as a term of endearment and later evolved into a given name. The name carries a sense of love, kindness, and devotion. The name Carrol carries the meaning “Darling, beloved” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Carrol usually hope their child will grow to embody darling, beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Carrol
in_english.meaning: name derived from family name of Carolus, meaning free man from the royal family
in_english.long_meaning: The name Carrol is derived from the family name of Carolus, which originated from the royal family of the Franks. The name Carrol has been in use since the 12th century and was popularized during the Middle Ages. It is associated with the qualities of a free man, independent and strong-willed. In Christian tradition, the name Carrol is also linked to the concept of freedom from sin and redemption.

data.cultural_impact: The name Carrol, though uncommon in the early 20th century, gained popularity through the works of renowned writers such as Washington Irving, who used the pen name 'Carroll' for some of his works, and most notably, Lewis Carroll, the celebrated author of Alice's Adventures in Wonderland. This nickname, with its endearing origin, lends itself to creative expression, as seen in these authors' works.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Carrol holds a significant spiritual meaning for Christians, as it can be seen as a reminder of the love and kindness shown by God towards His children. In the Christian context, carol refers to songs of praise sung during festive and celebratory occasions, emphasizing the joy and gratitude that come from acknowledging the divine presence in our lives. Furthermore, the name evokes a sense of comfort and protection, reminding us of the assurance God gives in delivering us from troubles and overseeing our lives with loving care.
